create_CtcCriterionConfig: create a CtcCriterionConfig dataclass to configure CTC loss with zero infinity and WER options
build_CtcCriterion: build a CtcCriterion instance with config and task to compute CTC loss for speech recognition
run_CtcCriterion_forward: run the CtcCriterion forward method to compute CTC loss and logging output from model predictions

review_CtcCriterion_WER_decoding: review the CtcCriterion forward method WER decoding logic using kenlm decoder and edit distance evaluation
